context: Extend the current SQLite registry with a preflight that opens existing state without mutation, creates a verified backup, records stable migration IDs and checksums, and applies one transactionally bounded migration at a time. Decision gate: stop and obtain architecture approval if a migration cannot be restored into a usable pre-migration registry, if stacked branches can reuse an ID with different SQL, or if implementation requires an additional operational database.
description: Create the storage safety floor before any PR 6 schema is reconsidered. The operational registry must be backed up and proven restorable before schema mutation, and every applied migration must have a stable ID and checksum. This item must not add teams, workers, cleanup, artifact adoption, or reporting behavior.

anti_patterns.dont: Add JSON history import as part of migration safety
anti_patterns.instead: Use SQLite backup and an explicit restore procedure
anti_patterns.why: Whole-history import introduces identity and collision semantics outside this scope

anti_patterns.dont: Proceed after backup creation without restoring and validating it in tests
anti_patterns.instead: Open the restored copy and validate schema, data, and audit history
anti_patterns.why: File existence is not recovery evidence

anti_patterns.dont: Treat PR branch order or an integer user_version as a unique migration identity
anti_patterns.instead: Use stable migration IDs with stored checksums and serialized merge order
anti_patterns.why: Stacked branches can reuse or reorder schema numbers

preserves.behavior: Backups and tracker state remain outside Git and are never staged or committed.
Existing schema-5 registries remain readable until an explicit approved migration runs.
No command creates or mutates a registry before ownership and version preflight succeeds.

prior_art.concept: existing schema initialization and version checks
